children: Evommune posted an updated corporate presentation highlighting pipeline advances, ~$287M cash and runway into 2029.
Posted updated corporate presentation on company website; furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K.
Reports ~$287M cash and investments, with expected runway into 2029—supports upcoming trials.
EVO301 showed Phase 2a POC in atopic dermatitis: 34% placebo‑adjusted EASI improvement and 23% IGA 0/1 at week 12.
Plans: EVO301 Phase 2b initiation mid‑2027; EVO756 Phase 2b top‑line migraine data expected 2027; EVO646 Phase 1 planned 1H 2027.
EVO756 and EVO646 positioned as novel oral programs targeting MRGPRX2 (migraine) and TLR7/8 (autoimmune) with claimed best‑in‑class potential.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Evommune posts updated corporate presentation outlining pipeline progress, cash runway and 2027–2028 milestones
